<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There are <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hidden Monokumas<CLT=cltSYSTEM> around the Ultimate
Academy. Maybe you've already seen one!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can collect <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hidden Monokumas<CLT=cltSYSTEM> by 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>investigating<CLT=cltSYSTEM> them.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Your collection will be displayed on
the shelf in this room, so get busy filling it!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>They're fun to look for when you
want to take a little break from everything.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, that's right. Tenko asked
me to set up a parasol.

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like she's gonna throw me
if I don't get it ready...

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway, what is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>?
It's still bothering me...
<CLT=cltMIND>And...why did Rantaro know?

<CLT=cltMIND>But I suppose I won't get anywhere
thinking about it by myself. Time for action...

There's still some time left today...
I need to think of a plan!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
